one_unusual_experiment.name: validation-collision counterfactual
one_unusual_experiment.question: Does corpus v1 validation actually hold out distinct generated scenarios, or can a random split look strong by repeating the same tiny deterministic scenario pool?
one_unusual_experiment.method: Replayed the exact generator choice process from source with seed 20260822 and fingerprinted family/prompt/latent generation choices that deterministically map to assistant output.
one_unusual_experiment.decision: Do not spend the owner training budget on corpus v1 as the canonical training candidate. Repair split/diversity first.

isolated_execution.environment: ChatGPT isolated Linux container; outbound DNS unavailable, so repository bytes were bound through GitHub connector blob identity rather than git clone

structural_validation.scope: equivalent copy of current validate_sft_v1.py logic; exact repo validator blob was not executed in this container

launcher.guard_behavior: An existing CREATE_ATTEMPTED_UNKNOWN guard aborts before Together client construction; no blind duplicate create.

byom_requirements: public Hugging Face repo or read token
compatible Together base template with matching architecture
together_current_external_evidence.supported_model_table_observation: Current public fine-tuning table contains Qwen3.5 entries down to 0.8B; no Qwen2.5 entry was found.
together_current_external_evidence.qwen25_template_status: OPEN_API_GATE; Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo remains a probe candidate only, not credited compatibility

training.blocker: Live Together API credential is not mounted; moreover public docs currently do not expose a documented Qwen2.5 fine-tuning template, so live BYOM/template admission remains the next discriminator.

next: Run launch_together_v2.py preflight with an environment-only Together credential.
